# `kevin setup`

Runs the environment's `setup` DAG. These steps persist across runs, such as
a shared kind cluster reused by many `kevin run`s.

```sh
kevin setup
```

See [Configuring an environment]({{< relref "/docs/environment-file" >}})
for the difference between a `setup` step and an `env` step.
